mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_route WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_route (order_id, seq, station_id, arrive_trip_no, planned_time, actual_arrive_time, arrive_operator_id, postman_id, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{seq}, #{stationId}, #{arriveTripNo}, #{plannedTime}, #{actualArriveTime}, #{arriveOperatorId}, #{postmanId}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS orderState, r.seq AS seq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, CASE WHEN r.seq = o.forward_station_count THEN dest.name ELSE COALESCE(prev_station.name, origin.name) END AS fromStationName, CASE WHEN r.seq = o.forward_station_count THEN CONCAT('收件人 ', o.receiver_name) ELSE dest.name END AS toStationName, r.arrive_trip_no AS tripNo, r.depart_time AS departTime, r.actual_arrive_time AS arriveTime, r.status AS legStatus, o.sender_name AS senderName, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, o.actual_weight AS actualWeight, o.actual_volume_cm3 AS actualVolumeCm3, o.quoted_price AS quotedPrice, o.price AS price, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, 'DELIVERY' AS taskType, r.remark AS remark FROM order_route r JOIN delivery_order o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN order_route prev ON prev.order_id = r.order_id AND prev.seq = r.seq - 1 LEFT JOIN station prev_station ON prev_station.id = prev.station_id LEFT JOIN station origin ON origin.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station dest ON dest.id = r.station_id WHERE r.postman_id = #{postmanId} AND o.state IN #{s} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS orderState, r.seq AS seq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, dest.name AS fromStationName, CONCAT('收件人 ', o.receiver_name) AS toStationName, r.arrive_trip_no AS tripNo, r.depart_time AS departTime, r.actual_arrive_time AS arriveTime, r.status AS legStatus, o.sender_name AS senderName, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, o.actual_weight AS actualWeight, o.actual_volume_cm3 AS actualVolumeCm3, o.quoted_price AS quotedPrice, o.price AS price, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, 'DELIVERY' AS taskType, r.remark AS remark FROM order_route r JOIN delivery_order o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN station dest ON dest.id = r.station_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND r.postman_id = #{postmanId} AND r.seq = o.forward_station_count LIMIT 1

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS orderState, 1 AS seq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, fs.name AS fromStationName, ts.name AS toStationName, NULL AS tripNo, NULL AS departTime, NULL AS arriveTime, 'PENDING' AS legStatus, o.sender_name AS senderName, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, o.actual_weight AS actualWeight, o.actual_volume_cm3 AS actualVolumeCm3, o.quoted_price AS quotedPrice, o.price AS price, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, 'RECEIVE' AS taskType, NULL AS remark FROM delivery_order o JOIN station fs ON fs.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = o.to_station_id WHERE o.state = 'AWAITING_RECEIPT' AND o.from_station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY o.create_time

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS orderState, 1 AS seq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, fs.name AS fromStationName, ts.name AS toStationName, NULL AS tripNo, NULL AS departTime, NULL AS arriveTime, 'PENDING' AS legStatus, o.sender_name AS senderName, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, o.actual_weight AS actualWeight, o.actual_volume_cm3 AS actualVolumeCm3, o.quoted_price AS quotedPrice, o.price AS price, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, 'RECEIVE' AS taskType, NULL AS remark FROM delivery_order o JOIN station fs ON fs.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = o.to_station_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.state = 'AWAITING_RECEIPT' AND o.from_station_id = #{stationId} LIMIT 1
